features.title: runSemanticKolSearch server module（fork from smart-match.ts）
features.acceptance: 新建 src/lib/discovery/semantic-search.ts (~150 行 fork from B7a-F002 smart-match.ts:115-200 范式)：export runSemanticKolSearch({tenantId, queryText, topK?}) → Promise<{kolIds: string[], cost: number, latencyMs: number, cacheHit: boolean}>；export class SemanticSearchError 含 codes INVALID_QUERY / EMBED_FAILED / DB_ERROR；复用 embedOne (src/lib/embedding/client.ts) — bge-m3 multilingual 1024-dim；复用 kolCosineTopKSql (src/lib/embedding/sql.ts) — pgvector ivfflat index；RLS via withTenant 包裹（与 SmartMatch 同模式）；Validate queryText 空 / >200 chars 抛 INVALID_QUERY；Latency budget cached path < 100ms / non-cached path < 500ms；新增 src/lib/discovery/__tests__/semantic-search.test.ts ≥4 case（empty query reject / >200 chars reject / valid query top-K returned / EMBED_FAILED 5xx mock）；npm run lint + tsc + test 全绿。详见 spec §F001。

features.title: UI integration — SearchBar AI chip + page.tsx 解析 ?ai=
features.acceptance: src/app/[locale]/(app)/discovery/SearchBar.tsx chip href 改：basePath?search=label → basePath?ai=label；src/app/[locale]/(app)/discovery/search.ts 加 semantic 路径检测 filters.aiQuery → 调 runSemanticKolSearch → 返回 cosine-ordered kolIds（自动 fallback 到 ILIKE 见 F003）；src/lib/kol/filters.ts 加 aiQuery?: string field + parseFilters / serializeFilters 同步处理 ai URL 参数；src/app/[locale]/(app)/discovery/ActiveFilters.tsx 加 '🤖 AI: <query>' chip 渲染 + 点 X 清空 ?ai=；AI search result grid 保持 cosine 顺序（不按 valueScore / followers / createdAt 排）— UI 上 sort dropdown disable + tooltip 'AI search uses semantic ranking'；npm run lint + tsc + test 全绿。详见 spec §F002 + D5 + D6。

features.title: Performance + Failure fallback (chip embedding cache + ENABLE_AI_SEARCH escape hatch)
features.acceptance: Module-level CHIP_EMBEDDING_CACHE Map<string, number[]>；preWarmChipCache() lazy first-request 触发（避免 cold start blocking）— 5 locale × 3 chip = 15 texts batch embed；Cache hit → cacheHit:true 在返回值；Cache hit rate ≥95%（chip click 不重复调 aigcgateway）；embedding service 5xx → fall back 到 ?search= ILIKE 路径（SemanticSearchError code=EMBED_FAILED → 自动 redirect URL）；env var ENABLE_AI_SEARCH=false short-circuit 退化到 ILIKE（与 BL-020 F005 / BL-034 F005 escape hatch 同模式）；.env.example 加 ENABLE_AI_SEARCH=true + comment；npm run lint + tsc + test 全绿。详见 spec §F003 + D3/D4。

features.title: Tests + Monitoring (event_log type='ai.usage' source='semantic_search')
features.acceptance: 单测 src/lib/discovery/__tests__/semantic-search.test.ts ≥4 case 已含 F001；新增 tests/integration/discovery-ai-search.test.ts ≥2 case（?ai=FPS 端到端 grid render with cosine hits / ?ai=GIBBERISH fallback to ILIKE empty state）；event_log 写入 type='ai.usage' source='semantic_search' payload={action:'discovery.semantic_search', queryText 前 50 chars, cost, cacheHit, kolIdsCount}（与 BL-034 F005 cost-cap MVP 集成）；BL-035 F003 AI rate-limit 自动 enforce（10/min/tenantId）；BL-034 F005 cost-cap MVP 自动 enforce per-tenant $5/day 上限；npm run lint + tsc + test 全绿 + CI 全绿。详见 spec §F004。
